# Portomatic

> Portomatic gives coding agents and engineers an ephemeral iPhone, booted in about 300ms.

Portomatic runs a real, emulated iPhone on demand. Each one is disposable: spin up a fresh
device for every engineer, agent, and task, then throw it away. Runs at any scale, with low
enough latency to keep an agent in the loop.

## Control surfaces

- API — drive a device programmatically
- CLI — spin up and script devices from the terminal
- iframe — embed a live device in the browser

## Facts

- Product: on-demand, ephemeral emulated iPhone
- Cold start: ~300ms
- Audience: coding agents, LLMs, and the engineers building them
- Canonical URL: https://portomatic.com/
- Contact: founders@portomatic.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/portomatichq/
